walkthroughs.body_html:
Fields — a core area of Physics.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Fields brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Fields.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Field strength relates to potential by:
options: E = +dV/dr
E = -dV/dr
E = V/r only
E = Vr

mcqs.q: Capacitance of parallel plate capacitor depends on:
options: Charge stored only
Voltage applied only
Area, separation, permittivity
Resistance of wires

mcqs.q: Is the cosmological redshift of distant galaxies a true Doppler shift?
options: No — it is caused by dust in space absorbing blue light.
The water turns into wave material and changes state.
No — it arises from the expansion of space stretching photon wavelengths during transit, not from the galaxy's motion through space.
Yes — it is the same Doppler shift as a moving siren on Earth.
